definitionZh: CSS的过渡期限属性设定了过渡动画完成所需的时间长度. 默认值为0s,表示不会发生动画.
sourceDefinition: The transition-duration CSS property sets the length of time a transition animation should take to complete. By default, the value is 0s, meaning that no animation will occur.
